entries.title: Agreeing to a plan starts the next safe step
entries.body: A ready plan's main button now starts the next step that is safe to start, whether that step changes your project or carries out an agreed operation. A later step that still needs you, such as a sign-in, waits. Save and defer and Abandon stay the other choices.
entries.noPicture: Nothing on screen changes by itself. The difference is which button a ready plan offers and that choosing it starts the next safe step.
